About NCC Cell
The National Cadet Corps Cell at KU unites students from different states of our country and makes them disciplined and responsible citizens of our Nation. Our campus provides an ideal space for students to engage in team-building activities and physical training sessions. It provides opportunities to develop a sense of commitment, leadership skills, discipline, dedication, and moral values. Its training programs shape the overall development of our young cadets, preparing them to serve for the betterment of society. NCC cadets are allowed to participate in adventure activities, including Mountain Treks and Expeditions, Trekking, Parasailing, Sailing, Scuba Diving, Kayaking, Camel Safari, and many more.

About Raipur
About Raipur
About Raipur
Raipur, the capital city of Chhattisgarh, is a blend of culture, heritage, and development. It is one of the fastest-developing cities of India and has become a centre of attraction in education, infrastructure, tourism, business, and Innovation. The city is famous for temples, parks, animal sanctuaries, the Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh International Cricket Stadium, food joints, shopping places, malls, & tribal heritage sites. It is home to some of the largest steel plants, IT industries, and manufacturing units.
About New Raipur
New Raipur is the first Greenfield Smart City in India, where 27% of the land is solely devoted to green and sustainable practices. It is also becoming a major hub of education and health in Central India. The Government is planning to make it a global destination for the IT and services industry to offer employment opportunities to youth. New Raipur is a well-planned smart city that supports a sustainable lifestyle and intelligent infrastructure. Due to growing opportunities and developments, it attracts students, entrepreneurs, and innovators who are ready to turn their ideas into innovation.

About Kalinga
Overview of Kalinga
Where Education and Purpose Align
Kalinga University, established in 2013, stands out as one of the leading private universities strategically located in the Smart City of New Raipur, Chhattisgarh. The University has consistently ranked among the top 101–150 universities in India under the NIRF Rankings 2025 for the fourth consecutive year. It has also received a NAAC B+ accreditation and NBA accreditation for the MBA Program, continuously shining on the horizons of high-quality education with equal opportunities to its international students.

Academic Facilities
Experience A Supportive Learning Environment
Academic Facilities
We nurture our students by providing them with all the essential academic facilities and support they need to excel in their chosen fields. They don’t just learn theoretical knowledge, but also learn from practical exposure and an experiential learning environment. With hands-on learning, they become confident and ready to take up challenges and stand out as a better individual.
Our Dynamic Academic Facilities
Digital Classrooms
Our classrooms have smart boards, projectors, and audio-visual tools, which make the learning fun and interactive, and students use them to give presentations.
Resource-Rich Library
Our library is packed with the latest collection of resources in the form of books, journals, research papers, digital resources, magazines, and newspapers.
Modern Laboratories
We have over 100 + labs, including a language lab, a central instrumentation facility, computer labs (with more than 1600 high-tech computers), and other research labs that offer sophisticated instruments, technologies, and advanced computer systems.
Incubation Centre
Kalinga Incubation Foundation (KIF) supports the unique entrepreneurial ideas of our students and helps them transform into successful startup ventures. We aim to fast-track your entrepreneurial growth by providing industry insights, networking opportunities, and seed funding support.
Moot Court
Our law students get a real courtroom experience with our Moot Court, where they put their legal skills into trials and participate in competitions, and gain confidence.
Centres of Excellence
We collaborate with leading industry partners to offer skill-based training across EVs (Eblu), IIoT (Technoviz Automation), Robotics, Coding & Drones (BDS Education), MSME (IamSMEofIndia), BRIDGE & Automation (BOSCH), AI & ML (IBM Innovation Centre), and Automobile Engineering (JustAuto Solutions).
Film Making Studio
We have a vibrant film making studio at our campus, equipped with lights, cameras, speakers, and editing tools that enable students to learn script-writing, acting, direction, production, lighting techniques, video editing, set design, camera handling, live streaming, and more.
Podcast Studio
Our podcast studio is a soundproof room equipped with high-quality microphones and equipment, providing students with an ideal space to practice and record content creation.
Central Instrumentation Facility
Every year, we provide on-campus internship opportunities to our students and conduct hands-on training programs on advanced instruments to improve their practical knowledge and technical expertise. We don’t just make our students academically strong but also job-ready with new skills so that they can meet industry demands.
ERP
We give every student access to the ERP portal, where they log in and get all sorts of information like the academic curriculum, exam timetable, notices, results, transportation details, and other information.
Animal House
To support experimental studies and research in the field of pharmacy, biotechnology, and life sciences, we have a safe and well-maintained animal house on our campus. We strictly adhere to ethical guidelines and safe practices in conducting practical experiments.
Audio-Visual Centre
Our audio-visual centre offers advanced tools and resources that support interactive learning, presentations, and projects of students.
Auditorium, Seminar Hall, & Board Rooms
We have a digitally-equipped and spacious auditorium with a seating capacity of 200 people, seminar halls, and board rooms where we regularly organise conferences, meetings, guest lectures, placement programs, training programs, events and activities, and much more.
E-Learning Rooms
The E-Learning Rooms at Kalinga University come with high-speed internet connection, printing facilities, and modern infrastructure. Our students can have access to digital libraries, online courses, research databases, and e-resources.
Training and Placement Cell
The training team conducts interview prep sessions, resume building, and soft skills training programs to fill the gap between academic learning and companies' expectations. The placement team organises campus drives to generate placement opportunities for graduate and postgraduate students.
Research Facilities
We have high-tech instruments at CIF, research labs for different streams, centres of excellence, an IPR cell, and dedicated faculty members who are always ready to guide, support, and mentor undergraduate, postgraduate, and Ph.D. students and research scholars in performing experimentation work and preparing reports.
Recording Studio
Our recording studio provides students and faculty members with a creative space where they can explore their artistic expression and produce high-quality audio and video content. It contains advanced tools, audio plugins, video systems, microphones, and pro-grade systems.
Business Lab
Our business lab features advanced computer systems and software that help commerce and management students master statistical tools, data analysis, and decision-making with an easy-to-use interface.
Statistical Database Lab
The lab equips students and research scholars to study various business parameters through advanced statistical analysis techniques. With our statistical database lab, they learn to analyse, interpret, and present the information in textual, tabular, and graphical forms in their research field.
Language Lab
A dedicated learning space designed for students to improve their language and communication skills in English and Hindi.
Hostel
We have fully-furnished hostels for girls and boys on our campus, where all necessary facilities are available along with tight security. We always strive to fulfil all the basic requirements of our hostelers, ensuring they never face any difficulty while living here.
Know More
Transportation Options
We have 30+ buses and four-wheel vehicles that provide pick-up and drop facilities with a comfortable travelling experience. Transport is offered at minimal rates, with faculty assigned proctorial duties in the morning and evening. Our buses and cars cover distances up to 70 km (one way).

About KALSEE
The Kalinga Scholastic Entrance Examination (KALSEE) is a Computer-Based Test for all the streams except BBA and MBA. It is an MCQ-based exam with flexible scheduling options and no negative marking.
Know More
About KAL-MAT
The Kalinga Management Aptitude Test (KAL-MAT) is an online entrance exam for BBA and MBA. It includes two steps: An online entrance exam and a personal interview.
Know More

Scholarships & Financial Assistance
Your hard work deserves a reward.
At Kalinga University, you don’t have to worry about the tuition fee as we’ve got you covered. Our scholarships are designed to help bright minds and talented students succeed in their careers.
Read More

Master These University Selection Hacks
Plan Your Finances Wisely
Perform well in your board exams and look for universities that provide scholarship options, as it will lower your financial burden.
Take Up Career Counselling
Select universities that have career counsellors, as they will help you identify your strengths, weaknesses, and interests.
Select Future-Proof Careers
Opt for high-demanding careers like AI, ML, Cybersecurity, Designing, Management, Engineering, Law, Pharmacy, and more.
Prioritise Colleges Offering Placements
Choose universities that have strong industry connections and provide internship opportunities or conduct campus placement drives.
Check University Accreditation
Choose accredited universities only as they offer recognised degrees, focus on holistic development, and provide quality education.
Think Beyond Academics
Select universities that offer hands-on training programs, facilitate research work, conduct workshops and seminars, and make you job-ready.
Look For Student Reviews
Before making your final decision, check out other students' opinions or interact with your seniors to understand academic quality.
Vibrant Campus Life
Take admission into a university that conducts various events, fests, celebrations, and competitions that complement academic learning.
Location and Connectivity
If the university is far from your home, ensure it provides transportation facilities for your safety and convenience.

Frequently Asked Questions
Am I eligible to take admission in Kalinga University?
It depends on the eligibility criteria of our academic programs. You need to meet the minimum eligibility criteria and clear the entrance exam of our University.
What is the admission procedure of Kalinga University?
Getting admission to our University is simple, transparent, and completely online. First, you need to register for the entrance exam, appear for the test, and complete the admission formalities after selection. Visit the admission procedure for more details.
Do I need to appear for the entrance exam before taking admission?
Yes, if you want to appear for BBA or MBA, then you need to take KAL-MAT - Kalinga Management Aptitude Test. If you want to pursue any other program apart from BBA or MBA, then you need to take KALSEE - Kalinga Scholastic Entrance Examination.
I am from another state. Can I still apply to Kalinga University?
Yes, it doesn't matter from which state or country you are; you'll be eligible to enrol in our academic programs once you meet the eligibility criteria of the program of your choice.
Will I get the hostel facility or accommodation?
Yes, we have separate boy's and girl's hostels at our campus, which offer all the basic amenities, a separate mess facility, and ensure the safety and privacy of all students with CCTV cameras and security.
Am I eligible for a scholarship?
We offer a wide range of scholarships to our students, but our admission counsellors will check your eligibility, and if you are found eligible, you can claim a scholarship on your tuition fee.
How can I pay my tuition fees?
Students can pay their fees via cash, UPI, Bank Transfer, or by cheque.
Are the programs of your University approved and recognised?
Yes, all our academic programs are approved and recognised by the relevant statutory and regulatory bodies.

Alumni
Alumni
About the KU Alumni Association
Continuing the Legacy of Success Together
The Kalinga University’s alumni network is an open platform where our students share their experiences and build lifelong connections. More than creating a network, our current students and alumni from different academic backgrounds share their experiences from their professional journey, offer tips and tricks on how to crack any job interview, and motivate candidates. Through alumni talks, collaborations, and mentorship programs, our current students learn about industry insights and new-age skills so that they can stand out in job interviews. The association's members also stay informed about the latest university achievements and activities.
Objectives
Career and Corporate Resource Centre
To share knowledge and experiences with current students and support them in their professional journey.
To organise mentorship programs and alumni talks to prepare students for future careers.
To recognise the academic and professional achievements of alumni.
To encourage the students to always be involved in research work, workshops, startups, and social and cultural events for an all-around development.
To encourage alumni to participate in events and share ideas and expertise for the continuous growth of students.
To inspire students to get involved in community development projects and social service actively.
Vision
To create an alumni community that empowers current students towards academic and professional excellence.
Mission
To actively engage our alumni and current students through events and programs, while supporting knowledge exchange, academic and professional growth, and lifelong learning.
Alumni Success Stories

Anti-Ragging Cell
Anti-Ragging Cell
Anti-Ragging Cell
Ragging is ruining the lives and careers of innocent students and even harming their health. Ragging is completely banned on our campus, and we take strict action against any student who is found guilty of ragging. Our cell ensures that every student pursues their education without the fear of harassment or bullying. As per the order of the Supreme Court of India, UGC guidelines, and State Government instructions, Kalinga University is following the “Zero-Tolerance Policy” towards ragging.
Vision
To create a ragging-free environment by promoting democratic values, compassion, empathy, and kindness among students so that they become responsible citizens.
Mission
Kalinga University is dedicated to creating a safe, secure, and inclusive environment for its students. Our goal is to eliminate all forms of ragging that cause mental and physical harm to our students.
Anti-Ragging Policy
Career and Corporate Resource Centre
As per the order of Supreme Court of India and subsequent Notification from University Grants Commission (UGC), ragging constitutes one or more of any intention by any student or group of students on:
Any Act of Indiscipline, Teasing, or Handling with Rudeness.
Any Act that prevents or disrupts the Regular Academic Activity.
Any Activity which is likely to cause Annoyance or Hardship.
Psychological Harm or Creates Fear or Apprehension.
Any Act of Financial Extortion or Forceful Expenditure.
Any Act of Physical Abuse causing Assault, Harm, or Danger to Health.
Any Act of Abuse by Spoken Words, Emails, SMS, or Public Insult, etc.
Any Act of Injury or Infringement of the Fundamental Right to Human Dignity.
Any Act of Wrongful Confinement, Kidnapping, Molesting or Committing Unnatural Offences, use of Criminal Forces, Trespass or Intimidation.
Any Unlawful Assembly or Conspiracy to Ragging. Any student or group of students found guilty of ragging on the campus or even outside the campus shall be liable to punishment(s).
Anti-Ragging Committee
Anti-Ragging Squad
Anti-Ragging Committee (2023-24)
The Anti-Ragging Committee is the Supervisory and Advisory Committee in preserving a culture of Ragging-Free Environment in Kalinga University Campus. The Anti-Ragging Squad- office bearers work under the Supervision of the Anti-Ragging Committee and engage in the work of checking places like Hostels, Buses, Canteens, Classrooms and other places of student congregation. The Anti-Ragging Committee is involved in designing strategies and an action plan for curbing the Menace of Ragging in the college by adopting an array of activities.

Cafeteria & Mess
Cafeteria & Mess
Cravings? We’ve Got You Covered!
Cafeteria & Mess
A healthy and balanced diet is an essential part of every student’s life, especially those staying away from home, either in hostels or PGs. In partnership with Sodexo, our University has a well-established mess facility, canteen, and cafeterias, where students can enjoy their meals together and make new connections.
Read More
Explore KU’s Food Corners
Mess
We have designed three spacious halls to accommodate large groups of students at a time and serve with different food options every day. Meals of both vegetarian and non-vegetarian plans are prepared and served to students as per their preference, serving 4 meals a day – breakfast, lunch, high tea, and dinner.Read More
Canteen and Cafeterias
Apart from the mess food, you can also explore some other options in our canteen and cafeterias. Campus Facilities
A Campus That Feels Just Like Home
At Kalinga University, experience college life that is fun, exciting, and makes you feel at home. It is a place where you will not just fulfil your ambitions but create life-long memories. Every day, you will get opportunities to learn something new under one roof. Our campus environment is designed to nurture innovative minds and make them skill-oriented.

Campus Facilities
Hostel
We have fully-furnished hostels for girls and boys on our campus, where all necessary facilities are available along with tight security. We always strive to fulfil all the basic requirements of our hostelers, ensuring they never face any difficulty while living here.
Mess
In partnership with Sodexo Food Solutions India Pvt. Ltd., we have a separate mess for boys and girls, serving 4 nutritious meals a day—breakfast, lunch, high tea, and dinner—that are freshly prepared and hygienic.
Canteen & Cafeteria
In partnership with Sodexo Food Solutions India Pvt. Ltd., explore our regular food and fast food items at the canteen. For fresh juices, snacks, or ice creams, our campus cafeterias offer delicious options at affordable prices.
Transportation Options
We have 30+ buses and four-wheel vehicles that provide pick-up and drop facilities with a comfortable travelling experience. Transport is offered at minimal rates, with faculty assigned proctorial duties in the morning and evening. Our buses and cars cover distances up to 70 km (one way).
Mini Market
The mini mart on campus includes an ATM facility, salon, stationery store, snack shop, juice centre, and chemist. It saves time for students and hostellers by meeting daily needs without having to step outside the campus.
Hostel Reading Room
We have a spacious reading room in the hostel that offers a quiet and comfortable environment. Students can study individually or in groups and prepare for exams, projects, or presentations without any membership requirement.
Health Clinic
Our on-campus health clinic has an experienced doctor and nurse who ensure the well-being of students and staff by providing general consultation, counselling, and emergency medical support.
Banking and ATM
We have tie-ups with Central Bank of India and Canara Bank for education loans. The campus also has two fully operational 24-hour ATMs from ICICI Bank and OBC Bank, along with support for digital payments like net banking, UPI, Paytm, and cards.
24/7 Wi-Fi Enabled Campus
Our campus is equipped with a high-speed 24/7 Wi-Fi-enabled network with multiple ISPs, offering up to 1 Gbps secure internet connectivity. The seamless Wi-Fi also supports the Learning Management System (LMS) for academic needs.
Safety & Security
The entire campus—including hostels, parking areas, and academic buildings—is secured by an in-house security team. CCTV cameras are installed across the campus to continuously monitor university activities.
Art Gallery
Our art gallery displays souvenirs from different countries brought by international students. It allows both national and international students to explore cultural diversity and global traditions.
Sanitary Napkin Vending Machines
Sanitary napkin vending machines are installed in all girls’ washrooms and hostels to ensure hygiene and round-the-clock accessibility, supporting the well-being of female students.
Recreation Corners
Need a break? Our peaceful recreational corners offer students a space to relax, socialize, and unwind from academic stress. These serene spots help students recharge and connect with peers.
Selfie Points
For those who love capturing moments, our picturesque selfie points across campus let students click memorable photos and share their experiences with friends and family.
Sports & Wellness Centre
We have indoor and outdoor sports facilities where students can play different games like carom, chess, table tennis, cricket, football, badminton, Hockey, Lawn Tennis, and more. We also have a dedicated yoga room that supports students’ emotional and mental well-being.
Gymnasium
We have separate boys’ and girls’ gym facilities on our campus for students who are residing in our hostels.

Campus Life
Campus Life
Get Ready to Explore a Thriving Campus Life
Life at Kalinga University
Your long-awaited feeling of experiencing college life finally begins. Step into a journey full of new learnings, exploration, and self-discovery, right from day one. Every day starts with a fresh sense of excitement, new connections, self-development, and opportunities that help you discover your potential and prepare for a successful future. As you move forward, you’ll gain confidence, independence, and clarity about your goals.
Focusing on student success and their holistic development, our learning environment goes beyond classroom education through academic events, extracurricular activities, and cultural celebrations. It adds excitement to their daily routines and makes learning feel purposeful. At Kalinga, students don't just enjoy campus life; they get prepared to make a mark in evolving industries. Your new adventure begins, make it unforgettable!
Life at Kalinga — Beyond Classrooms
Facilities
02/06
Canteen
The KU canteen offers more than just food — it offers comfort. Fresh, hygienic meals and a variety of snacks keep students energized throughout the day. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite between classes or relaxing with friends, the canteen is a space everyone loves.
Canteen
Future-ready learning, right from day one
Academics at KU are all about practical knowledge and experiential learning that enable students become confident and ready to take up real-world challenges. Through interactive lectures, industry-oriented curriculum, digital classrooms, a resource-rich library, and supportive faculty, students learn to apply every concept in real life.
Turning their curiosity into innovation
Experience a research-driven learning culture where students are encouraged to explore beyond textbooks and make an impactful contribution. At KU, students learn to apply their theoretical knowledge in laboratory work and gain confidence to explore new possibilities. Students are actively involved in discoveries that actually matter.
Celebrations
Keeping the campus vibe alive
From festivals and cultural days celebrations to achieving University milestones, we make every moment count. Students come together to perform, celebrate, and create unforgettable memories. Music, dance, colours, and smiles all around fill the campus with excitement and joy, turning every moment into lifelong friendships.
Sports
Fueling spirit, performance, and teamwork
KU aims to make every student active and energised by promoting a balance between academics and sports. Indoor and outdoor games, a gymnasium, and yoga help students build confidence and focus better on studies. Regular participation reduces their stress while strengthening them physically and mentally.
Always buzzing with something exciting
Kalinga Utsav, Sports Day, Anand Mela, Induction Programs, Convocation Ceremony, Ideathon (Business Plan Competition), Hackathon (Coding Competition), Industrial Visits, Workshops, International Tours, and more add energy to campus life. Students get endless opportunities to participate, compete, and showcase their talents.
Networking Opportunities
Turning new connections into opportunities
Guest lectures, alumni meets, seminars, and global conferences bring industry exposure right to the campus. Every interaction adds value to students' professional journey. They discover new horizons, gain industrial insights, and learn to make smarter career decisions.
Community Service
Learning empathy beyond classrooms
Through our NCC and NSS departments, students are encouraged to give back while learning teamwork, discipline, and leadership qualities. Through cleanliness drives, blood donation camps, awareness campaigns, social and sustainable initiatives, and rural outreach, students develop a deeper understanding of social responsibility.
Internships and Placement Drives
Turning their dreams into impactful careers
Career preparation at KU starts early through internship programs (on-campus and off-campus), enabling students gain confidence and industry experience. Our training and placement cell provides 360-degree training to students, preparing them for on-campus placement drives.
Recreation Corners
Your chill zones are right on campus
Need a break? Recreation corners across campus give students a place to relax, recharge, and hang out with friends. These chill-out spots are perfect for short breaks to improve productivity and social bonding.
Eco-Friendly Campus
Learning in harmony with nature
Kalinga's green campus promotes sustainable practices and develops a sense of awareness and responsibility among young students. It is a space where students learn the importance of protecting the environment while enjoying a calm and refreshing atmosphere that supports their mental and physical well-being.
Hostel Life
Comfort, safety, and a home-like vibe
Hostel life at KU is all about convenience and lifelong bonds. CCTV cameras, 24/7 security, comfortable accommodation for both boys and girls, a hygienic mess facility, and a mini-market ensure students get everything they need under one roof. It's a place where students share experiences and learn to support each other like a family.
Multicultural Learning Environment
Where cultures meet, and friendships grow
Students at KU experience a vibrant multicultural environment where they learn and grow alongside their peers from across India and around the globe. Daily interactions introduce them to new languages and perspectives. They celebrate diversity, build new connections, and exchange ideas as they prepare for a global career.
Experience the KU Vibe
Our students don’t just attend college they experience a whole new and exiting college life. Each day brings opportunities to explore, connect, and create memories that last a lifetime.

Frequently Asked Questions
How can I apply for a job at Kalinga University?
You can apply directly through our official careers page by filling out the Career Application Form and uploading your updated resume. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our HR team for further rounds of the selection process.
What types of positions are available at Kalinga University?
We offer opportunities for teaching, non-teaching, marketing, and administrative roles across various departments. Open positions are updated regularly on our website under the “Open Positions” section.
What qualifications are required to apply for teaching positions?
Applicants should possess a postgraduate degree or Ph.D. in the relevant discipline, as per UGC norms. Relevant teaching and research experience will be an added advantage.
Does Kalinga University offer internships or training opportunities?
Yes, Kalinga University provides internships and professional training for both fresh graduates and students. These programs help participants gain practical exposure and industry-relevant skills.

Central Instrumentation Facility
Central Instrumentation Facility
Central Instrumentation Facility at KU
To fulfil the research needs in science and technology at a higher level, Central Instrumentation Facility are established at Kalinga University for students, faculty members, and research scholars. A wide range of advanced instruments, including an X-Ray Diffractometer (XRD), 3D Printer, Bio-Chemistry Analyser, and many more, are available for in-depth experimentation work under one roof. We also welcome researchers from other universities, organisations, and NGOs, promoting collaboration across different departments.
Read More
Vision
To position our Central Instrumentation Facility at the top in research standards in the field of basic and applied sciences. The aim is to facilitate researchers with high-end tools and technologies so that they can explore new horizons and address complex challenges.
Mission
To build a resource-rich environment where researchers can work with modern instruments, receive technical guidance, and produce impactful research outcomes that can be published in reputed journals.
Objectives of CIF
Career and Corporate Resource Centre
Explore state-of-the-art instruments that support advanced research across various disciplines.
To motivate students to pursue research work by providing them with highly advanced instruments.
To assist research scholars, faculty members, and UG/PG/PhD students in their projects or dissertations as part of their curriculum.
To promote academics and industry collaboration.
To provide reliable research outcomes that can be used for patenting and publishing.
To analyse samples of researchers of KU and other institutes.
To sign MoUs with organisations and industries for collaborative research work.
To provide training and guidance on how to operate a machine, data collection, and data analysis.
To organise hands-on training programs, workshops, seminars, conferences, and symposia.
To conduct certification programs in advanced instrumentation technologies.
To create networking opportunities with research organisations for collaborative growth.
What Do We Offer?
The Central Instrumentation Facility at Kalinga University provides state-of-the-art research infrastructure and comprehensive support services. From providing access to advanced instruments to conducting skill development programs, we support researchers at every step and promote industry-academia collaboration. Whether you're a student, faculty member, research scholar, or industry professional, our tools and expertise will support your research and innovation goals.
Advanced Instrumentation Access
CIF at KU offers access to modern instruments that support advanced research work that needs high precision across multiple disciplines.
Quick And Reliable Results
Our time-tested machines minimise the time in delivering outcomes while maintaining accuracy and consistency in every analysis.
Customised Research Solutions
To help researchers with diverse academic and industry needs, we provide personalised research support and guidance in complex data analysis and sample testing.
Skill Development Programs
We conduct workshops, certification courses, and training programs to promote research culture apart from offering access to instruments.
Dedicated CIF Experts
Our committed research faculty members and coordinators work rigorously to provide researchers with complete guidance and support.
Collaborative Research Partnerships
We partner with researchers across various industries to work on a joint project and produce impactful research results.
Equipments
The CIF at Kalinga University is well-equipped with advanced research facilities that produce accurate measurements in the biological, physical, and chemical sciences.

Chairman
Chairman
Dr. Rajeev Kumar
Chairman
Education must not only inform minds but ignite purpose and shape responsible leaders of tomorrow.
Chairman's Message
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to the Kalinga University, where we believe that education is not just about classroom learning but about inspiring learners to pursue lifelong knowledge.
Due to globalisation, the competition has tremendously increased in every field, including education. To cope with that, we have developed a smart curriculum that turns students into job-ready professionals. We focus on imparting a holistic learning experience that makes them well-rounded in emotional, intellectual, and ethical standards. With a motive to deliver quality education, we proudly inform you that we rank between 101-150 top universities in India under the NIRF Rankings, 2025. We are also a NAAC B+ accredited university, proving our commitment to academic excellence.
We have a multi-cultural campus environment with students from 33+ countries. KU offers a range of programs, a sustainable campus, an interdisciplinary learning environment, centres of excellence, advanced research labs, expert faculty members, an industry-ready curriculum, and impeccable networking opportunities. Academics are just one part of our university, but we also emphasise co-curricular, extracurricular, and community service. We just don’t nurture young minds, but encourage them to go beyond their boundaries, discover their strengths and weaknesses, and become responsible citizens.
At KU, students don’t just earn degrees; they graduate with confidence and purpose to make a thoughtful change in society. As you step into a new journey with us, we assure you that you’ll always feel motivated and inspired every single day of your life.
I welcome you all to Kalinga University and wish all the best in your career and life.

चेयर के बारे में
कलिंगा विश्वविद्यालय में शहीद वीर नारायण सिंह चेयर की स्थापना छत्तीसगढ़ के महान स्वतंत्रता सेनानी के सम्मान में की गई है। इस चेयर का उद्देश्य छात्रों को छत्तीसगढ़ की जनजातीय समाज, कला, संस्कृति, परंपराओं और व्यक्तित्व से परिचित कराना है। इसके माध्यम से विश्वविद्यालय में विभिन्न सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम जैसे नृत्य, संगीत और अन्य गतिविधियों का आयोजन किया जाता है, जिससे छात्रों की सक्रिय भागीदारी बढ़े। साथ ही, अतिथि व्याख्यानों के जरिए विशेषज्ञों और प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्तियों द्वारा छात्रों को छत्तीसगढ़ के इतिहास, संस्कृति और सामाजिक मूल्यों की जानकारी दी जाती है। यह चेयर छात्रों में शोध की रुचि विकसित करने के साथ-साथ क्षेत्रीय विरासत के संरक्षण और प्रसार में भी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है।
चेयर के उद्देश्य
छत्तीसगढ़ के इतिहास, कला, संस्कृति एवं लोकसाहित्य के विशेषज्ञों की उपस्थिति में संगोष्ठियों का आयोजन करना।
शहीद वीरनारायण सिंह की जयंती एवं पुण्यतिथि पर विभिन्न रचनात्मक प्रतियोगिताओं का आयोजन करना।
छत्तीसगढ़ की कला, संस्कृति एवं साहित्य से संबंधित अंतविश्वविद्यालयिन स्तर पर शोध कार्य को प्रोत्साहित करने हेतु विभिन्न कार्यक्रमों का आयोजन करना।
शहीद वीरनारायण सिंह शोध संस्थान की स्थापना करना, जिसके माध्यम से छत्तीसगढ़ के राष्ट्रीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम सेनानियों से जुड़े तथ्यों पर नवीन शोध कार्य करना।
विश्वविद्यालय के विद्यार्थियों के लिए निबंध लेखन, भाषण, वाद-विवाद एवं अन्य सांस्कृतिक प्रतियोगिताओं का आयोजन करना।

Chancellor
Chancellor
Dr. Sandeep Arora
Chancellor
True progress begins when learning inspires responsibility, resilience, and the courage to create change.
Chancellor's Message
I feel honoured and privileged to lead Kalinga University at a time when higher education is being modified and redefined at a global level. The National Education Policy 2020 has set new standards with a bold vision, and we are committed to following its core values. Our mission is to combine knowledge with purpose, helping students develop curiosity and interests in their field of study.
At Kalinga, we surpass conventional learning by using modern teaching practices and creating an environment where students are turned into holistic beings and can put their learning into action. With an aim to pursue excellence in every parameter, KU also offers an environment where non-academic pursuits of students are also achieved alongside the academic curriculum. Striking a balance between the two, we offer 130+ academic programs along with world-class infrastructure that incorporates research facilities, advanced laboratories with high-tech instruments, an expansive library with all the latest resources, an auditorium, A-1 level sports facilities, a fully-equipped gym, recreation centres, separate boys and girls hostel facilities, and other dedicated spaces for extracurriculars.
We constantly strive to introduce changes into our education systems so that students are well-prepared for the rapidly changing world and develop a global perspective. With national and international tie-ups, we conduct conferences and seminars so that our students meet with industry leaders or popular personalities and learn to lead in the competitive world.
I would like to conclude by saying Rabindranath Tagore’s timeless words, “The highest education is that which does not merely give us information but makes our life in harmony with all existence.”
Wishing you all great success!

Chhattisgarh
Chhattisgarh
Discover Chhattisgarh
A Land Rich in Culture, Heritage & Diversity
Located in the heart of India and also known as the ‘Rice Bowl of India’, Chhattisgarh is known for its popular temples, waterfalls, and historical sites. It has become a hub for students, researchers, travellers, and entrepreneurs due to growing opportunities in education, sustainable development, innovation, and exploration. It is famous for its Dhokra (bell metal) art, terracotta sculptures, and bamboo crafts that are admired globally for their detailing and precision. Chhattisgarh offers an inspiring learning environment and lifestyle.
About Raipur
Raipur, the capital city of Chhattisgarh, is a blend of culture, heritage, and development. It is one of the fastest-developing cities of India and has become a centre of attraction in education, infrastructure, tourism, business, and Innovation. The city is famous for temples, parks, animal sanctuaries, the Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh International Cricket Stadium, food joints, shopping places, malls, & tribal heritage sites. It is home to some of the largest steel plants, IT industries, and manufacturing units.

About the Program
Have you ever wondered how impossible visuals are used in movies and games?
A Bachelor of Animation & Visual Effects (B.An & VFX) program is an exciting and creative career option for individuals interested in bringing their unique ideas to the screen. The program focuses on creating moving images and visuals for the entertainment industry, using various artistic and technical skills for games, films, television, and other digital platforms. Students learn 2D and 3D animation techniques, character design, VFX simulations, storyboarding, and the tools and software used in the industry.
Duration : 3 Years (6 Semesters)
Eligibility Criteria
10 + 2
Qualify the Entrance Test:KALSEE
Your Next Big Chapter Starts With One Click

Career Pathways
Discover future-ready career opportunities where technology meets creativity and intelligence.
Compositing Artist
Combine multiple visual elements and create a realistic final image.
Texturing Artist
Create and apply textures to 3D models in games, movies, and animations.
3D Animator
Create 3D space, characters, and objects using advanced animation techniques.
VFX Artist
Create realistic effects like a transformation or an explosion by combining footage.
Storyboard Artist
Plan camera angles, shots, and scenes before production begins.
Motion Graphics Designer
Create animated visuals by combining animation, graphic design, and storytelling.
Game Animator
Use animation software to develop characters, objects, and creatures.
Video Editor
Convert raw footage into a final polished video using different editing software.
Character Designer
Bring characters to life through sketches, digital arts, and 3D models.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the B.An & VFX Program at Kalinga University all about?
The Bachelor of Animation & Visual Effects (B.An & VFX) Program focuses on creative storytelling using animation and visual effects. Through this program, students learn 2D and 3D animation, motion graphics, video editing, character design, VFX techniques, multimedia storytelling, and more.
Is there an entrance exam to enrol in this program?
Yes, to enrol in the B.An & VFX program, you’ll need to appear for the Kalinga Scholastic Entrance Examination (KALSEE). To know more, visit - KALSEE.
What is the fee structure of this program?
For detailed fees information, please refer to the Fees section mentioned above.
What are the career opportunities after completing this degree?
Graduates can explore diverse career opportunities and work as 2D Animators, 3D Animators, Visual Effects Artists, Motion Graphics Designers, Storyboard Artists, Character Design Artists, Video Editors, Multimedia Content Creators, and more.
Does Kalinga University provide internships or placement opportunities to students?
Yes, we conduct on-campus and off-campus internship programs for our students and even provide on-campus placement assistance where top recruiters hire graduates. Moreover, our training and placement team conducts personalised training programs, preparing students with the latest industry-relevant skills.

About The Program
A Bachelor of Arts (BA) in Journalism and Mass Communication, along with PSC coaching, is an undergraduate program that prepares students with the knowledge and skills required in different media-related fields like digital media, print media, advertising, public relations, and more, while simultaneously preparing for competitive government exams. With this program, students are well-prepared with journalistic skills like gathering information, writing, and editing, which shape public opinion through their powerful stories. They also develop essential skills, like knowledge of trending tools and technologies, research and gathering information, and communication, which are critical in this field. This program is designed for students who want to pursue broad career options through competitive government exams, while gaining a degree in J & MC. With integrated media education, PSC coaching, and practical sessions, students develop extraordinary skills and knowledge that keep them ahead in this industry.

About The Program
The Bachelor of Arts (BA) degree with a Public Service Commission (PSC) coaching program enable students to pursue a career in civil services and earn a recognised degree. Our curriculum covers subjects related to the Bachelor of Arts degree and PSC exams that are taught and mentored by our experienced faculty members, who use experiential learning methods, skills and strategies, and mock test preparation that are needed to excel in PSC exams. With this program, students can begin their preparation right after their 12th grade, manage their time effectively, and reduce their overall cost of preparation.
You can choose from the following subjects that align with your interests and PSC exams requirements:
Read More

Your Next Big Chapter Starts With One Click

Career Pathways
BA graduates have options to choose from different careers or even excel in multiple careers according to their interests.
Public Relations Executive
Manage a company or organisation's public image and reputation by handling press releases, public messages, and events.
Social Worker
Work with NGOs or join the government programs and work on social issues.
Research Assistant
Support research work by collecting and analysing data, and preparing research reports.
Political Analyst
Understand political trends, interpret the political system and policies, and forecast potential outcomes.
Translator
Translate books, documents, or scripts in different languages and work as a bilingual translator.
Museum Assistant
Handle administrative duties, ensure cleanliness and security, support in exhibition planning, and maintain heritage collections.
Content Developer (Education Sector)
Write educational materials for schools, colleges, or coaching centres.
Civil Services Aspirant
Get prepared for UPSC, PSC, or other competitive government exams.
Librarian
Oversee the cataloguing, maintenance, and organisation of physical and digital collections, and adapt to the latest technologies.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the BA with PSC Coaching Program at Kalinga University all about?
The Bachelor of Arts (BA) degree with a Public Service Commission (PSC) Coaching Program prepares students with various subjects like Economics, Geography, History, Political Science, Psychology, Public Administration, and Sociology, along with structured preparation for various competitive government exams.
Is there an entrance exam to enrol in this program?
Yes, to enrol in the BA with PSC Coaching Program, you’ll need to appear for the Kalinga Scholastic Entrance Examination (KALSEE). To know more, visit - KALSEE.
What is the fee structure of this program?
For detailed fees information, please refer to the Fees section mentioned above.
What are the career opportunities after completing this degree?
Graduates can explore diverse career opportunities and work as Survey & Statistics Executives, Heritage Research Assistants, Community Wellness Program Assistants, Social Survey Assistants, Administrative Assistants, Public Relations Executives, Museum Assistants, Data Documentation Executives, and more.
Does Kalinga University provide internships or placement opportunities to students?
Yes, we conduct on-campus and off-campus internship programs for our students and even provide on-campus placement assistance where top recruiters hire graduates. Moreover, our training and placement team conducts personalised training programs, preparing students with the latest industry-relevant skills.

About The Program
The Bachelor of Business Administration and Bachelor of Law (BBA LLB) is a dual-degree program that combines both business management and legal studies, preparing students to lead in the corporate and legal world. This program makes students legal professionals who have a strong understanding of both corporate laws and business practices. Along with classroom learning, our students gain practical knowledge through moot courts, internships, and project work. This course is a smart choice for those who want to make their career in corporate law or legal consultancy.

What is the BBA LLB Program at Kalinga University all about?

About The Program
The Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Film Making is an undergraduate degree program that provides a comprehensive knowledge of different aspects of film making. It prepares students with skills and knowledge that are required to pursue roles in film and television or other digital media industries. The broad curriculum of our program covers research, editing, script writing, sound design, production, direction, cinematography, set design, lighting systems, and editing software, and they gain a complete practical knowledge in our on-campus Film Studio. From pre-production to post-production, they are being trained in different disciplines according to their interests through workshops, projects, and internships. Apart from this, they will also get the opportunity to work with professionals and industry experts so that they can enter the professional world early.

About The Program
A Bachelor of Computer Applications in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (BCA in AI & ML) is an undergraduate program that combines computer science principles along with AI and ML training. With this program, students will learn to develop AI and ML applications, and they will also be able to analyse data using statistical and machine learning techniques. It covers the fundamentals of computer applications while providing specialised training in AI and ML, such as machine learning algorithms, Natural Language Processing, data analytics, neural networks, database management, automation, cloud computing, computer vision, and knowledge of AI tools and their architectures. They will learn skills to develop AI-powered solutions and build intelligent systems through lab training, workshops, case studies, internships, project works, and much more.
Duration : 3 Years (6 Semesters)
Eligibility Criteria
10 + 2
Qualify the Entrance Test:KALSEE

Career Pathways
Explore future-ready careers in artificial intelligence and machine learning.
Junior AI Developer
Assist senior developers in building AI applications and intelligent systems.
Junior Data Analyst
Find trends and patterns in structured and unstructured datasets.
AI Chatbot Developer
Design conversational chatbots that improve customer interactions.
AI Tools Specialist
Assist businesses in using specific AI tools that can automate tasks and solve complex problems.
NLP Assistant
Design and develop algorithms for various NLP tasks.
AI Research Assistant
Collect and organise data on emerging AI technologies and prepare case studies and reports.
AI-Powered Automation Executive
Help businesses automate repetitive tasks through AI applications.
AI Testing and Quality Analyst
Develop and implement testing strategies to improve AI and ML model performance.
AI Support and Deployment Engineer
Assist clients in setting up AI software across their systems and troubleshoot issues.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the BCA in AI & ML Program at Kalinga University all about?
A Bachelor of Computer Applications in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning is an undergraduate program that introduces students to smart systems and emerging AI technologies. Through this program, students learn programming languages, machine learning models, NLP, deep learning, AI tools, data structures, and more.
Is there an entrance exam to enrol in this program?
Yes, to enrol in the BCA in AI & ML Program, you’ll need to appear for the Kalinga Scholastic Entrance Examination (KALSEE). To know more, visit - KALSEE.
What is the fee structure of this program?
For detailed fees information, please refer to the Fees section mentioned above.
What are the career opportunities after completing this degree?
Graduates can explore diverse career opportunities and work as AI Engineers, Data Analysts, Python Developers, AI Application Developers, Automation Engineers, Computer Vision Assistants, AI Research Assistants, Software Developers, and more.
Does Kalinga University provide internships or placement opportunities to students?
Yes, we conduct on-campus and off-campus internship programs for our students and even provide on-campus placement assistance where top recruiters hire graduates. Moreover, our training and placement team conducts personalised training programs, preparing students with the latest industry-relevant skills.

About The Program
The Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) is an undergraduate degree program designed for individuals who are interested in the teaching-learning process for students of upper-primary (classes VI-VIII), secondary level (classes IX-X), and senior secondary level (classes XI-XII). It is for those who aspire to become school teachers or those who are already working as assistant teachers and want to teach higher classes. The blended curriculum prepares students with innovative teaching methods, classroom management techniques, curriculum development, educational psychology, knowledge of education-related tools and technologies, and pedagogical skills.
Duration : 2 Years (4 Semesters)
Eligibility Criteria
Only students who appear in the State Entrance Exam are Eligible. Graduation or Post Graduation or its equivalent with minimum 50% marks. 5% relaxation in the minimum percentage of marks will be given to the candidates belonging to SC / ST / OBC Categories.
Qualify the Entrance Test:KALSEE
Your Next Big Chapter Starts With One Click
Admission Open
Fees

Career Pathways
B.Ed graduates are well-prepared to take up careers in teaching and other educational areas and learn to incorporate innovative teaching practices.
Primary School Teacher
Teach different subjects to young students and create an engaging learning environment.
Secondary School Teacher
Plan lessons based on your subject expertise and teach middle and high school students.
Senior Secondary Teacher
Guide senior students on important topics in various streams, including commerce, science, and arts and humanities.
Special Education Teacher
Mentor students with special needs using different learning styles.
School Administrator
Manage different departments and activities related to overall institutional development.
Academic Coordinator
Coordinate with teachers and students and ensure academic programs align with institutional goals.
Curriculum Developer
Draft curriculum for schools and institutes by using their academic materials.
Online Tutor
Teach different age-group students virtually and provide personalised guidance.
Educational Content Writer
Prepare lesson plans, activity sheets, textbooks, and digital content.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the B.Ed. Program at Kalinga University all about?
The Bachelor of Education Program is designed to prepare aspiring educators with pedagogical skills, classroom management techniques, communication skills, curriculum development, digital tools, critical thinking, and inclusive teaching practices. The program emphasises hands-on learning experience through internships and classroom-based activities.
Is there an entrance exam to enrol in this program?
Yes, to enrol in the B.Ed. Program, you’ll need to appear for the Kalinga Scholastic Entrance Examination (KALSEE). To know more, visit - KALSEE.
What is the fee structure of this program?
For detailed fees information, please refer to the Fees section mentioned above.
What are the career opportunities after completing this degree?
Graduates can explore diverse career opportunities and work as Primary/ Secondary/ Higher Secondary Teachers, Special Education Teachers, Online Tutors, School Administrators, Curriculum Developers, Academic Counsellors, Educational Researchers, and more.
Does Kalinga University provide internships or placement opportunities to B.Ed. Students?
Yes, we conduct on-campus and off-campus internship programs for our students and even provide on-campus placement assistance where top recruiters hire graduates. Moreover, our training and placement team conducts personalised training programs, preparing students with the latest industry-relevant skills.

About The Program
Introducing the Bachelor of Fashion Design (B.FD) for students who are born fashionistas and want the world to know their passion for fashion. The program prepares students to shine in the competitive national and international industry of fashion through creative, technical, intellectual, and communication skills. Our FD students learn pattern making and draping, garment construction techniques, CAD and 3D Design tools, textile and fabric knowledge, creative concept development, fashion trend analysis, personal styling, fashion branding, eco-friendly fashion and zero-waste techniques, custom design, fashion communication, and client interaction. We make our students industry-ready through workshops, internships, industrial visits, fashion shows, projects, and collaborations.
Duration : 3 Years (6 Semesters)

Fashion CAD Specialist

Apparel Quality Analyst
Ensure garments meet quality standards throughout the manufacturing process.
Fashion Production Assistant
Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers, manage timelines for bulk production, and handle day-to-day operations.
Retail Fashion Coordinator
Create engaging store displays and coordinate with brands to boost sales.
Pattern-Making Assistant
Support designers in creating precise designs with accurate cutting, sizing, and draping techniques.
Fashion Blogger / Influencer
Share personal styles on social media platforms and work with brands.
Footwear Designer
Select materials, analyse trends, and create new footwear designs.
Fashion Entrepreneur

About The Program
Introducing a Bachelor of Interior Design (B.ID) program for creative individuals who have an eye for every detail and who are passionate about transforming spaces into unique living experiences according to the preferences and budgets of clients. The program combines the science and art of creating functional and appealing interior spaces within a particular area. It prepares students with creative visualisation, design fundamentals, CAD and 3D tools, space planning and layout, lighting design, furniture and fixture design, sustainable interior practices, client handling skills, and communication skills. With our detailed classroom sessions, workshops, guest lectures, internships, and industrial projects, students develop a detailed understanding of how the interior design business runs and the latest trends followed by top industry professionals.

Interior Stylist

Sustainable Interior Designer

About The Program
The Bachelor of Law (LLB) is an undergraduate program that serves as a gateway for graduates aspiring to enter the legal profession. It is a foundational law degree that introduces students to the constitutional frameworks, the Indian legal system, and courtroom sessions. Pursuing an LLB course helps students develop advocacy skills that are required in both public and private legal sectors. With this program, students will be well-trained in both theoretical and practical aspects of the legal system and develop legal acumen. Students will actively engage in legal cases and participate in moot court competitions.
Duration : 3 Years (6 Semesters)
Eligibility Criteria
The candidate should have a graduation degree with 45% aggregate marks.
Qualify the Entrance Test:KALSEE

Career Pathways
Pursuing an LLB program prepares students with strong legal knowledge that is essential to make informed decisions and solve challenging cases.
Litigation Lawyer
Prepare case files and advocate for clients in the courtroom.
Consumer Protection Lawyer
Fight for consumer rights and advocate for compensation.
Legal Tech Policy Consultant
Bridge the gap between legal frameworks and technologies.
Custom & Excise Legal Assistant
Represent custom departments in courts and manage disputes.
Insurance Claims Legal Advisor
Represent insurers and clients for claims, damages, or fraud cases.
Legal Content Creator
Educate the audience on trending legal topics on different platforms.
Legal Data Entry Operator
Maintain case records, contract clauses, and case summaries.
Courtroom Coordinator
Guide lawyers and clients, and ensure the smooth functioning of courtroom proceedings.
Legal Translator
Translate notices, judgments, and affidavits between languages.
Moot Court

Our law students gain real courtroom experience through our Moot Court, where they apply their legal knowledge in simulated trials, participate in practical training sessions and competitions, and build the confidence required for a successful legal career.

About The Program
The Bachelor of Library & Information Science (B.Lib.) program is for those who want to make a career in modern libraries and information centres. It is a systematic study of library and information science, where students will learn to manage and maintain physical and digital information resources. The program prepares students with cataloguing and classification, library automation, preservation techniques, database management, digital library management, information analysis, research skills, communication skills, and much more. With this program, they will be able to manage library resources and develop innovative library management solutions.
Duration : 1 Year (2 Semesters)

10 + 2

Information Desk Officer
Become the first point of contact for students and researchers, and help them navigate the library resources.
Digital Library Assistant
Manage digital collections, e-resources, and online archives.
Technical Library Support Executive
Provide IT support and troubleshoot technical issues in library operations.
Junior Archivist
Support in preserving and organising historical collections and manuscripts.
Library Operations Coordinator
Perform staff supervision, manage collections, oversee library space, and supervise memberships.
Research Support Assistant
Assist students and researchers in locating journals and references.
Library Membership Coordinator
Manage library subscriptions, memberships, and user registrations.
Institutional Repository Assistant
Maintain institutional knowledge databases like academic papers, reports, and dissertations.

About The Program
The Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharmacy) is an undergraduate program that focuses on the study of theoretical and practical aspects of pharmaceutical sciences, including drug manufacturing and development, as well as the effects of medicines on the human body. With a strong focus on innovation and the latest technologies, we offer extensive research facilities through various labs, including Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Analysis Lab, Machine Room, CIF Lab, and more. These facilities provide students with exceptional hands-on training, enabling them to become professional pharmacy graduates. Apart from this, we also provide them with internships and clinical placements in top organisations.

Lateral Entry

About The Program
Ever imagined how medicines work inside your cells or how your body turns food into energy?
The answer lies in Biochemistry. The Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry is an undergraduate degree program that prepares students with a detailed understanding of different biochemical processes and their impact on living organisms. It prepares students with strong observation skills and an ability to analyse and interpret experimental data. Within this program, our students study Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Immunology, Biochemical Techniques, Clinical Biochemistry, Environmental Biochemistry, and much more. With our hands-on training programs, advanced lab sessions, and research projects, they become industry-ready.

About The Program
Ever wondered how scientists prepare customised medicines or decode your DNA?
That’s where Bioinformatics comes in. A Bachelor of Science in Bioinformatics is an undergraduate degree program that is a combination of Biology, Computer Science, and Statistics used to analyse biological data such as protein structures through computational tools. Our advanced curriculum prepares students with the necessary skills to handle large datasets and obtain meaningful conclusions. This program covers Molecular Biology, Genetics and Genomics, Systems Biology, Biostatistics, Computational Biology, Drug Discovery and Design, and much more, preparing students for the Biotechnology industry, Pharmaceutical industry, and advanced research.
Duration : 3 Years (6 Semesters)
Eligibility Criteria
10+2 with Relevant Subject
Qualify the Entrance Test:KALSEE
Your Next Big Chapter Starts With One Click
Admission Open
Fees
Scheme & Syllabus
Career Pathways
Follow your curiosity and explore unlimited career opportunities in the world of science.
Bioinformatics Analyst
Analyse proteomic, genomic, or metabolomic data to support R&D.
Computational Biologist
Study complex biological systems using algorithms and computational models.
Clinical Bioinformatician
Apply bioinformatics tools for genetic diagnosis and treatment planning.
Biomedical Data Analyst
Use statistical tools and datasets, and interpret biomedical data.
Structural Bioinformatics Researcher
Study 3D structures of biomolecules for drug discovery or the development of new therapies.
Bioinformatics Software Developer
Develop software applications for biological data analysis.
Cheminformatics Analyst
Use computational techniques to analyse chemical and molecular data.
Biotech Data Visualisation Specialist
Simply complex biological datasets into a clear structure, such as charts or graphs.
Genetic Data Consultant
Perform genetic data analysis for personalised medicines or biotechnology.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the B.Sc. in Bioinformatics Program at Kalinga University all about?
The Bachelor of Science in Bioinformatics Program is a combination of biology, computer science, and statistics that focuses on analysing complex biological data like proteins, DNA, and genomics using computational tools to understand diseases, develop personalised medicines, or discover drugs.
Is there an entrance exam to enrol in this program?
Yes, to enrol in the B.Sc. in Bioinformatics Program, you’ll need to appear for the Kalinga Scholastic Entrance Examination (KALSEE). To know more, visit - KALSEE.
What is the fee structure of this program?
For detailed fees information, please refer to the Fees section mentioned above.
What are the career opportunities after completing this degree?
Graduates can explore diverse career opportunities and work as Bioinformatics Analysts, Data Analysis Assistants, Computational Biology Assistants, Clinical Data Analysts, Biological Database Curators, and more.
Does Kalinga University provide internships or placement opportunities to students?
Yes, we conduct on-campus and off-campus internship programs for our students and even provide on-campus placement assistance where top recruiters hire graduates. Moreover, our training and placement team conducts personalised training programs, preparing students with the latest industry-relevant skills.

About The Program
Ever wondered how tomatoes stay fresh for a longer period on supermarket shelves or how corns these days have no worms inside?
Well, the science behind these everyday wonders is Biotechnology. It is when biology meets technology to tackle real-world challenges and improve people’s lives by using cells, living organisms, and biological systems, and creating solutions for agriculture, the environment, healthcare, and industries. The B.Sc. in Biotech program at Kalinga University is designed to provide students with the latest industrial knowledge with a balance of theoretical knowledge, hands-on training, live projects, research collaborations, lab sessions, and internships, preparing them to become researchers and scientists. We give our students exposure to advanced biotech techniques in genetic engineering, bioinformatics, molecular diagnostics, and fermentation technology.

Biotech Entrepreneur
Identify and develop innovative products for healthcare, agriculture, and the environment.

Develop eco-friendly practices to address environmental problems using microbes.
Food Technologist

About The Program
Are you interested in solving mysteries or uncovering hidden truths from clues?
Introducing the Bachelor of Science in Forensic Science (B.Sc. in Forensic Science), a program that focuses on scientific and technical knowledge and skills to investigate crime scenes by applying different principles. Our students pursuing this program learn techniques like collecting, processing, preserving evidence, and identifying suspects. They will learn skills like crime scene investigation, fingerprint analysis, forensic toxicology, forensic biology and DNA profiling, digital forensics, forensic chemistry, bloodstain pattern analysis, forensic photography, criminal behaviour analysis, forensic instrumentation skills, case study analysis, and much more. Our primary focus is to provide students with practical knowledge through hands-on training, laboratory work, case study research, and field work.
Duration : 3 Years (6 Semesters)

Crime Scene Investigator
Perform documentation, collection, and preservation of evidence at the crime scene.
Forensic Laboratory Assistant
Prepare evidence and samples for analysis, maintain lab equipment, record scientific data, and assist researchers.
Fingerprint Analyst
Use forensic technology to examine and match fingerprint patterns.
Forensic Photographer
Capture high-quality images of crime scenes and evidence.
DNA Analyst
Collect, analyse, and interpret DNS tests using scientific techniques.
Toxicology Lab Assistant
Handle specimens, maintain instruments, and conduct tests to detect toxins or chemicals.
Document Examiner
Analyse handwriting, signatures, and prepare comparison charts.
Bloodstain Pattern Analyst
Analyse blood patterns to reconstruct crime events.
Forensic Ballistics Trainee
Analyse firearm-related evidence such as bullets, cartridge cases, and gunshot residue.

About The Program
Ready to deliver world-class hospitality experiences?
A Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) in Hotel Management Program at Kalinga University is designed to provide students with an extensive knowledge of Food and Beverage Services, Front Office Operations, Food Production, Food Safety and Quality, Accountancy, Housekeeping, Facility Planning, and Customer Service. It prepares students professionally through both theoretical knowledge and practical training, enabling them to understand real-world hotel operations.
The industry-relevant curriculum emphasises communication skills, leadership qualities, teamwork, and professional ethics. Through internships and industry exposure, students excel in every parameter and adapt to evolving hospitality trends. They are prepared to build successful careers in hotels, resorts, cruise lines, and travel and tourism sectors.

About The Program
Have you ever wondered how invisible worlds can create superfoods and save lives?
Well, these smallest organisms hold the power to solve the biggest challenges of humanity. The B.Sc. in Microbiology is an undergraduate degree program that involves the study of the pathogenic potential of different organisms, including viruses, protozoa, fungi, and bacteria that cause diseases in human beings. With our advanced course curriculum, we prepare students with theoretical and practical concepts that include laboratory sessions and research projects. Under this program, students learn Food and Dairy Microbiology, Medical and Clinical Microbiology, Industrial Microbiology, Environmental Microbiology, and more. By studying a Bachelor of Science in microbiology, they learn to develop vaccines and diagnostics to fight infectious diseases, improve food safety and quality, boost agricultural practices, develop biodegradable products, and discover new microorganisms.

Develop methods to detect microorganisms that cause human diseases.

Identify food-borne pathogens and ensure the safety and quality of food products.
Industrial Microbiologist
Develop vaccines, antibiotics, and food products using microbial processes.
Research Associate in Microbiology
Perform lab experiments on bacteria, viruses, and fungi.
Pharmaceutical Microbiologist
Develop microbiological testing methods for drugs and vaccines.
Public Health Microbiologist
Study and identify harmful microorganisms to control and prevent public health hazards.
Environmental Microbiologist
Investigate microorganisms in environments like air, soil, and water.
Agricultural Microbiologist
Research microorganisms to develop sustainable farming practices.
Fermentation Specialist
Use microbial processes in the fermentation for food, medicines, and beverages industries.

About The Program
The Bachelor of Science in Yoga is an undergraduate degree program that focuses on yoga and management skills through classroom-based studies and practical sessions. The curriculum combines ancient theoretical knowledge about yoga with methods specific to modern lifestyles. With this program, students learn different types of yoga asanas, pranayama techniques, meditation methods, yoga therapy, session planning, instruction techniques, lifestyle and health management tips, communication skills, and much more. This course is for those who want to become yoga instructors or practitioners, helping millions of people stay fit and healthy.

What is the B.Sc. in Yoga Program at Kalinga University all about?

About The Program
The Bachelor of Science in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics is designed to provide students with a detailed knowledge of the main science subjects and their practical applications. It is for those who are interested in laws of nature, molecules and matter, and mathematical theories. With this program, students learn about classical and quantum physics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, modern physics concepts, organic, inorganic, and physical chemistry, data analysis, mathematical modelling, probability, statistics, laboratory skills, research methods, instrumental methods, and much more. Through our laboratory sessions and project work, students perform experiments, learn to analyse data, and solve challenging problems.

About The Program
A Bachelor of Science in Zoology, Botany, and Chemistry program provides students with theoretical and practical knowledge of animal sciences, plant biology, and chemical principles. The program aims to provide knowledge of natural laws through logic and justifications behind every observation, experimentation, modelling, and calculation. With our modern labs and field-based projects, we ensure that you are always learning by doing. In this program, students explore animal anatomy, genetics, wildlife diversity, ecological interactions, animal behaviour and reproduction, microscopy studies, biodiversity surveys, plant genetics, plant structure and classification, medicinal plants, sustainable agricultural practices, plant metabolism and reproduction cycles, organic, inorganic, and physical chemistry, molecular structure, chemical bonding, modern lab instruments, environmental chemistry, and much more.

About The Program
If you are interested in constructing bridges, buildings, transportation systems, or highways, then civil engineering is the perfect career option for you. B.Tech in Civil Engineering is an undergraduate program that focuses on planning and construction of infrastructural projects using scientific and mathematical principles. The main objective of the program is to provide our students with knowledge of civil engineering principles and their applications. With this program, they will be able to solve the infrastructural challenges, understand different construction processes, and learn to use the latest technologies in civil engineering. They will also understand the construction process of sustainable infrastructure and smart cities.

What is the B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering Program at Kalinga University all about?
The Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science is an undergraduate engineering program that prepares students with technical skills in software development and emerging technologies. Through this program, students learn programming languages, data structures, operating systems, algorithms, computer networks, and more.
Is there an entrance exam to enrol in this program?
Yes, to enrol in the B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering Program, you’ll need to appear for the Kalinga Scholastic Entrance Examination (KALSEE). To know more, visit - KALSEE.

For detailed fees information, please refer to the Fees section mentioned above.

Graduates can explore diverse career opportunities and work as Software Engineers, Full Stack Developers, Backend Developers, Frontend Developers, Database Engineers, Mobile App Developers, Web Application Engineers, IT Solution Engineers, and more.
Does Kalinga University provide internships or placement opportunities to students?
Yes, we conduct on-campus and off-campus internship programs for our students and even provide on-campus placement assistance where top recruiters hire graduates. Moreover, our training and placement team conducts personalised training programs, preparing students with the latest industry-relevant skills.

About The Program
Are you ready to rule the world of intelligent machines, or do you want to master futuristic skills that companies are actually looking for?
With Kalinga University’s Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Program, with an expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (B.Tech CS in AI & ML), you will be ready to build machines that understand, predict, and learn like human beings. The program focuses on practical applications of AI and ML techniques, including Machine Learning Algorithms, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Deep Learning, Big Data Analysis, Programming Languages Foundation, Computer Vision, Data Science, AI Ethics, and much more. In collaboration with the IBM Innovation Center for Education, students learn industry-relevant skills and advanced tools from their tech experts. Apart from this, they also work on real-world projects, participate in Hackathons (coding competitions), and take up internships that help them crack job interviews. With this program, students develop potential skills and abilities that help them develop AI-based technologies.

The Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering is an undergraduate program that includes designing, analysing, manufacturing, and maintaining different mechanical systems. It covers topics like thermodynamics, machine design, fluid mechanics, and much more. The objective of the program is to prepare students to enter industries like aerospace, automotive, manufacturing, and energy. Our mechanical engineering curriculum is designed to enable students to take up the responsibilities and challenges of the sector and come up with innovative solutions.

About The Program
Interested in designing futuristic games powered by AI?
The Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) in Game Development with Artificial Intelligence Program, offered in collaboration with Hi-Tech Animation, is for students who want to bring innovation and creativity to the gaming industry. The program combines core computing concepts along with programming, graphics, simulation systems, and AI technologies, enabling students to create next-generation gaming experiences. Through industry-relevant curriculum and practical learning, students also understand how AI and machine learning can enhance gameplay, character behaviour, and interactive environments.

About The Program
The Diploma in Computer Applications (DCA) is a short-term program that provides foundational knowledge in computer applications. It is a shortcut to learn IT skills and enter entry-level positions in the tech industry. The program covers fundamental aspects, including programming languages, database management, system analysis, MS Office, web design, and much more. After completion of the program, students will be ready for entry-level jobs in IT, administration, and business operations. They will learn the latest tools and technologies and will also be able to use computer science principles in the practical world.

What is the DCA Program at Kalinga University all about?

A Diploma in Civil Engineering provides practical knowledge in infrastructural development, which includes planning, designing, and maintaining buildings, roads, tunnels, dams, ports, and bridges.
